correctness.rationale: PASS: For the Zorn split octonions in odd characteristic, the direct seven-coordinate bracket is alternating and trace-zero; its trace-pairing gives the Fourier adjoint identity. The kernel dimension of ad_x on trace-zero space is 7 for x=0, 3 for nonzero isotropic Q(x)=0, and 1 for anisotropic Q(x)≠0. Consequently the bracket Fourier transform takes q^14,q^10,q^8. The seven-dimensional nondegenerate quadratic-cone character sum K(z) is q^6 at zero, 0 at nonzero isotropic z, and q^3χ(Q(z)) elsewhere. Fourier inversion followed by two free scalar coordinates yields precisely q^11+q^10−q^5, q^9−q^5, and q^9−q^5+(q^8−q^6)χ(Q). Output strata mass totals q^16. Fresh independent F3 adjoint rank evaluation checked all 3^7=2187 x and four representative target linear systems; it is not a proof for arbitrary q.
